findings.title: Inherited umask changes storage behavior
findings.detail: Runner calls os.umask(0o077) without child override. Original storage:98 PASS/1 FAIL; buffered mode600, want0644. Creation mode0644 is masked to0600.
findings.recommendation: Pin test-child umask022; explicitly retain task HOME/TMP/state0700. Preserve original and replay with fresh run identities; do not weaken assertions.

findings.title: Temporary ancestor violates secure-root policy
findings.detail: All35 artifact failures report adapter unavailable. openSecureRoot rejects non-root-owned group/world-writable ancestors. Read-only stat proves /Volumes/artisan UID501 mode0775; test TMP is below it. Secure /private/tmp diagnostic passes all78 named cases on unchanged source.
findings.recommendation: Allocate canonical task TMP under /private/tmp with secure ancestors and0700 leaves. Keep production safety policy; no Git or adapter implementation change is needed.

findings.title: Auth shared limiter is skipped
findings.detail: Runner sets REDIS_TEST_URL only; shared limiter requires MULTICA_TEST_REDIS_URL. Original auth normal:116 PASS/1 SKIP.
findings.recommendation: Set actual opt-in to owned Redis in corrected run, then reconcile its named PASS. Preserve skipped original.

findings.title: Redis URL DB numbers are overridden
findings.detail: Helpers force DB11,13,15 and FlushDB. Serial execution inside this lane does not demonstrate a collision. Redis owner is recorded, but runner does not reverify it.
findings.recommendation: Parent must reserve actual helper-selected DBs against other lanes and verify Redis owner/port; generated URL DB numbers do not prove isolation.

findings.title: complete flag does not establish acceptance
findings.detail: summary.complete compares result count only; independent of exits, failures, skips, malformed JSON or source_matches. Recorder does not verify duplicate terminals or historical name omissions.
findings.recommendation: Require independent raw named reconciliation and final source/tool/resource audit; never promote complete:true to PASS.

findings.title: Current embedded builtin skill differs from frozen source
findings.detail: Go list confirms changed SKILL.md is a service EmbedFile and service lies in production/test dependency closures of eight selected packages including cmd/multica. Frozen-to-current prose retains human credential and revision-conflict semantics. The only other changed recorded file is e2e/fixtures/inbox-snooze.ts, outside Go test inputs.
findings.recommendation: Keep acceptance bound to frozen manifest. Parent should verify current embedded content/packaging and new build/source identity; no evidence requires all81 behavioral packages to rerun for prose-only drift.
